pr_title: Support custom AABBs within MultiMesh resources
pr_body:
- Supporting custom AABBs on MultiMesh resources themselves allows us to prevent costly runtime AABB recalculations.
- May also help improve CPUParticle performance.

Fixes #79573

issue_context.title: AABB for multimesh will calculated even with custom AABB `instance_set_custom_aabb`
comments:
It seems like the ``_multimesh_re_create_aabb()`` function should have an early out when a custom AABB is being used similar to what happens with ``mesh_get_aabb()``

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/b8ed596769d2114797015833ce86f86ee872ecfa/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/mesh_storage.cpp#L600-L606

This might require adding an API for assigning a custom_aabb to the multimesh as right now it is only possible to assign an AABB to a mesh or to a GeometryInstance (to the node). The MultiMesh resource doesn't have a custom_aabb

Yeah I look at **multimesh** it does not have custom AABB
But I think this will be easy to add
Specially this will be useful for **CPU Particle** as many use them in older devices
I agree. Recalculating the AABB is a very costly operation. Especially with high particle amounts

Related old issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/957

Specifically, please see my analysis of the custom AABB issue for the 3.x branch: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/957#issuecomment-711417650 . I'm not sure if the code I mention has changed a lot in 4.x or not, hopefully it might help.

review_comments: This condition should be in the GLES3 version as well
